name: veyq-admin-web
//: The Server-Owner administration surface as its own deployable (ADR 0065). A pure client of the existing backend Admin API — no DB, no KEK, no new backend surface. It shares exactly ONE thing with `web/`: @veyq/crypto, because first-run setup performs a real cold account birth and a second copy of that would be a security defect. Everything else (router, state, UI, generated client) is this package's own, on purpose.

scripts.generate:api: openapi-generator-cli generate -g typescript-fetch -i ../contracts/api/setup.openapi.yaml -o src/api/generated --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,typescriptThreePlus=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelDocs=false,modelTests=false && openapi-generator-cli generate -g typescript-fetch -i ../contracts/api/auth.openapi.yaml -o src/api/generated/auth --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,typescriptThreePlus=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelDocs=false,modelTests=false && openapi-generator-cli generate -g typescript-fetch -i ../contracts/api/tenants.openapi.yaml -o src/api/generated/tenants --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,typescriptThreePlus=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelDocs=false,modelTests=false && openapi-generator-cli generate -g typescript-fetch -i ../contracts/api/instance.openapi.yaml -o src/api/generated/instance --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,typescriptThreePlus=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelDocs=false,modelTests=false
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
